correctness.rationale: Positive definiteness follows from eigenvalues 1±rho, 0<rho<1. Any balanced size-two selection law has the three-pair-matching parametrization. Enumerating the four marginal outcomes yields exact closed two-moment recurrences u_{k+1}=ru_k, z_{k+1}=alpha*r*z_k-(1-alpha)*rho*u_k/2, whose geometric-series solution proves the all-horizon identities including alpha=0 and alpha=1. Sign of C and monotonicity of alpha^k establish optimizer reversal. Analytical ratio simplifies to (1+rho^2)/(1-rho), which diverges as rho tends to 1 from below. Standalone exact-rational path verifier checks 1024 finite identities and inequalities, not infinity.

value.rationale: A fixed-size-two balanced batch law on four coordinates is the first small genuinely variable joint-coupling design with fixed marginals; two coupled SPD pairs supply a natural model of interacting features. Even though Euclidean MSE is exactly invariant under every such sampling, objectives can reverse preference based on alignment and the risk contrast becomes unbounded near ill-conditioning at identical communication/update budget. It isolates a structural limitation of marginal-only comparisons and provides an all-horizon analytic benchmark; no claims of generalized algorithmic superiority or faster exponent.
